ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with ~85% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) and ~15% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated in localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels form circular and annular clusters (10-50 pixel diameter) primarily distributed across the distal half of the right fluke lobe and the trailing edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 85-degree internal angle at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge exhibiting high-frequency irregular peaks and valleys; prominent jagged indentations at the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge profile with both lobes exhibiting an upward sweep from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast white rings and solid white circular blobs concentrated on the right lobe, particularly near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular jagged interruptions of the trailing edge contour and numerous annular surface markings across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bulbous nodules at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
